purpose: Source-discovery and research-testing candidate lanes, not evidence of completed studies.

status_meanings.candidate: Source family and test contract defined; no external record admitted or test run.
status_meanings.active: A particular study/dataset with frozen provenance admitted.
status_meanings.tested: A reproducible experiment and actual witness attached; not necessarily confirmed.

global_boundaries: No bulk imports of all research; choose a testable question then freeze a bounded source snapshot.
Every claim requires source ID, DOI/record ID when present, version, retrieved_at UTC, rights review, data transformation, and witness pointer.
Separate paper, preregistration, dataset, simulation and observed result; one is not proof of another.
Do not ingest credentialed/identifiable human data or start human-subject experiments without separate authority and consent.
No unapproved network crawling, third-party vulnerability testing, clinical interventions, or executable dataset scripts.
Original researchers' conclusions are hypotheses to examine, not workstation-validated findings.
Preserve UNKNOWN and conflicting results; no inferred cross-domain generality.

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.boundary: Public scholarly metadata search; access terms and quotas apply.

sources.name: Crossref
sources.boundary: Publisher-deposited metadata; abstracts and full text may have separate rights.

sources.name: Open Science Framework
sources.boundary: Public registrations, materials and metadata; individual project file rights vary.

sources.name: Zenodo
sources.boundary: Record metadata and linked files; check each record's license and version.

sources.name: OpenML
sources.boundary: Datasets, tasks, evaluation design and runs; verify each dataset's terms.

sources.name: Hugging Face Datasets
sources.boundary: Per-dataset licenses, privacy and dataset cards must be checked.

sources.name: NCBI E-utilities / PubMed
sources.boundary: Bibliographic indexing is not evidence of causal validity or full-text reuse rights.

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2
sources.boundary: Study records can be registered/reported but are not verified treatment outcomes.

sources.name: PhysioNet
sources.boundary: Some datasets are credentialed or restricted; never automatically download them.

sources.name: OpenNeuro
sources.boundary: Check deidentification, dataset status, subject conditions and download scope.

sources.name: PubChem PUG REST
sources.boundary: Compound records contain distinct computed and observed property sources.

sources.name: NIST Chemistry WebBook
sources.boundary: Standard reference values require unit and condition matching; check reuse terms.

sources.name: NASA Earthdata CMR
sources.boundary: Catalog metadata and imagery are different artifacts; granule rights and access vary.

sources.name: NOAA NCEI CDO
sources.boundary: API token required; define spatial, temporal and station comparability.

sources.name: GWOSC
sources.boundary: Event catalogs and strain series have different evidence and analysis requirements.

sources.name: World Bank Indicators
sources.boundary: Series revisions and operational definitions must be pinned before comparison.

sources.name: OECD SDMX data
sources.boundary: Terms and rate limits apply; check revisions and comparability.

sources.name: NIST NVD
sources.boundary: Advisories and applicability records are not proof that a target is exploitable.

lanes.name: Research discovery and evidence synthesis
lanes.question: Can independent metadata indexes resolve the same DOI and update history?

test_contract.measurement: DOI/title match and source update fields
test_contract.counterexample: Mismatch, missing record or conflicting publication metadata

lanes.name: Methods, preregistration and reproducibility
lanes.question: Is a frozen protocol distinguishable from a later outcome claim?

test_contract.measurement: registration timestamp, version and linked outputs
test_contract.counterexample: No preregistration or outcome link; retain UNKNOWN

lanes.name: Mathematics and formal proof studies
lanes.question: Can a stated result be reconstructed from stated assumptions?

test_contract.measurement: Exact finite examples, counterexamples and versioned formal inputs
test_contract.counterexample: Failure beyond tested domain or unproved generalization

lanes.name: Algorithms and computer systems
lanes.question: Does a reported algorithm improve a declared baseline under the same inputs?

test_contract.measurement: Frozen data split, runtime and measured output
test_contract.counterexample: Reproducibility or complexity mismatch

lanes.name: Machine learning and ARC-like tasks
lanes.question: Does a model's behavior generalize to held-out examples and tasks?

test_contract.measurement: Seeded split, leakage audit and performance by task
test_contract.counterexample: Training-test leakage or performance collapse

lanes.name: Robotics, controls and autonomy
lanes.question: Does a finite controller preserve its stated safety and tracking bounds?

test_contract.measurement: Trajectory, control constraints and disturbances
test_contract.counterexample: Violation in any recorded trial; simulation not hardware

lanes.name: Physics and dynamical systems
lanes.question: Do two candidate dynamical descriptions agree on independently observed signals?

test_contract.measurement: Time-aligned measured traces and residuals
test_contract.counterexample: Bound exceeded or observation model mismatch

lanes.name: Chemistry, thermodynamics and materials
lanes.question: Do predicted properties match reference data under identical conditions?

test_contract.measurement: Units, temperature, pressure, species identity and uncertainty
test_contract.counterexample: Unmatched physical conditions or uncertainty excess

lanes.name: Molecular biology and structural data
lanes.question: Does an external dataset support a stated molecular relation without species or assay mismatch?

test_contract.measurement: Dataset version, assay/structure identity and effect direction
test_contract.counterexample: Confounding conditions or mismatched assay

lanes.name: Clinical research and trial records
lanes.question: Can registry history and published outcomes be reconciled without conflating clocks?

test_contract.measurement: Record identifiers, change timestamps and public aggregate fields
test_contract.counterexample: Source chronology ambiguous or restricted records

lanes.name: Neuroscience and physiological signals
lanes.question: Can a predeclared signal processing pipeline replicate a published feature?

test_contract.measurement: Dataset snapshot, preprocessing, segmentation and confidence interval
test_contract.counterexample: Pipeline drift or non-reproducible result

lanes.name: Psychology, cognition and behavior
lanes.question: Does a preregistered effect hold under public-study recomputation?

test_contract.measurement: Design, exclusions, effect size and uncertainty
test_contract.counterexample: Missing preregistration or sensitivity to exclusions

lanes.name: Earth systems and climate
lanes.question: Can independent observations be compared on the same spatial and temporal grid?

test_contract.measurement: Geospatial coordinates, units, time span and missing-data policy
test_contract.counterexample: Grid/unit mismatch or station selection bias

lanes.name: Astronomy and gravitational wave events
lanes.question: Can a published event feature be reproduced from a pinned public event version?

test_contract.measurement: Event version, signal parameters, error bars and processing
test_contract.counterexample: Event-version change or unmodeled observation error

lanes.name: Economics and economic forecasting
lanes.question: Does a forecast beat a naive baseline on held-out historical intervals?

test_contract.measurement: Release vintages, horizon, errors and baselines
test_contract.counterexample: Lookahead leakage or revised series hidden

lanes.name: Social science and demographics
lanes.question: Are demographic associations robust to definition, period and country coverage?

test_contract.measurement: Indicator metadata, cohort units and effect robustness
test_contract.counterexample: Aggregate-to-individual inference or group definition drift

lanes.name: Education and learning research
lanes.question: Can reported learning outcomes be reproduced from a study's public analysis?

test_contract.measurement: Study design, scoring and subgroup uncertainty
test_contract.counterexample: Outcome selection or missing denominator

lanes.name: Audio, music and perception
lanes.question: Can a measurable audio feature survive encoding and playback transformations?

test_contract.measurement: Sample rate, feature method and reference clip version
test_contract.counterexample: Non-reproducible feature or license incompatibility

lanes.name: Games, virtual worlds and agent interaction
lanes.question: Does the same policy yield the same trace under controlled resets?

test_contract.measurement: Reset seed, state-action sequence, event trace and held-out cases
test_contract.counterexample: Divergent trace, hidden-state dependence or benchmark leakage

lanes.name: Software security and robustness
lanes.question: Does a bounded local test reproduce a documented failure without touching third parties?

test_contract.measurement: CVE version, local sandbox, negative control and fix condition
test_contract.counterexample: Non-reproduction or unsafe/external targeting

lanes.name: Human factors and interface design
lanes.question: Do changes improve a measured interaction task without suppressing accessibility?

test_contract.measurement: Task definition, usability metric, accessibility checks
test_contract.counterexample: Accessibility regression or inconsistent task conditions
